summary: Iteration 16 - Role-based access control and Odoo inventory testing. Backend: 21/21 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Director (15 nav items + 8 inventory tabs), Manager (6 nav items + location tracking), Ground Staff (3 nav items + location tracking) all working correctly. BUG FOUND: Custom role user (arun@sp.com) gets NO nav items due to permission filter mismatch.

ui_bugs.issue: Custom role user (arun@sp.com) sees NO navigation items because: 1) Ground staff base nav items have permissions (view_dashboard, manage_tasks, view_reports) that aren't in their custom role 2) Custom role only includes (edit_accounting, view_accounting, edit_inventory, view_inventory) 3) All base nav items get filtered out
No routes defined for /accounting or /inventory even if ground_staff user has those permissions

action_items: Fix custom role permission handling - either: (a) Include 'view_dashboard' in all custom roles by default, OR (b) Don't filter Dashboard nav item by permission for logged-in users, OR (c) Add the custom role permissions to user's permissions array instead of replacing defaults
Add routes for /accounting and /inventory to GroundStaffDashboard.js if user has those permissions
Modify Layout.js getNavItems() to include nav items based on user's actual permissions, not just system role
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: Custom role user arun@sp.com (ground_staff with job_role) gets permissions ['edit_accounting', 'view_accounting', 'edit_inventory', 'view_inventory'] but these don't match any nav item permissions in the ground_staff base list
The Layout.js getNavItems() returns base items for system role, then filters by hasPermission() - this means custom roles need to include ALL permissions including view_dashboard for basic navigation
GroundStaffDashboard.js Routes only include /tasks and /reports - no routes for /accounting or /inventory

bugs_found.issue: Custom role user (arun@sp.com) sees no navigation items
bugs_found.root_cause: 1) Layout.js getNavItems() returns base list for system role (ground_staff), which only includes Dashboard/Tasks/Reports with permissions view_dashboard/manage_tasks/view_reports. 2) Custom role only has edit_accounting/view_accounting/edit_inventory/view_inventory. 3) hasPermission filter removes all items since none match.
bugs_found.reproduction_steps: 1. Login as arun@sp.com / password123. 2. Observe empty sidebar navigation. 3. Check console - user.permissions = ['edit_accounting', 'view_accounting', 'edit_inventory', 'view_inventory']
bugs_found.suggested_fix: Modify custom role system to: (a) Always include view_dashboard permission for all roles, (b) Extend Layout.js getNavItems() to include additional items based on user permissions not just system role, (c) Add accounting/inventory routes to GroundStaffDashboard
